mapper.select: SELECT activity_report_document_id, activity_record_id, representative, location, created_dttm, updated_dttm FROM activity_report_document WHERE activity_record_id = #{activityRecordId}

SELECT activity_report_participant_id, activity_report_document_id, display_order, name, department, student_no, note, created_dttm, updated_dttm FROM activity_report_participant WHERE activity_report_document_id = #{activityReportDocumentId} ORDER BY display_order
